title: DXF wire-order, reference-role, recovery, and comparator-maturity boundary
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only plan/test audit; plan-only
scope: Reconcile official DXF wire-order and handle-role rules with the current implementation plan and generated tests.
Distinguish strict DXF parsing from recovery/audit and distinguish peer support declarations by exact operation, direction, version, and tool.
Refine existing PAR-05/7AR, PAR-16/7A, PAR-20/7G, and PAR-07/S8 readiness without duplicating controls or promoting external support claims.

sources.revision: Current public Autodesk help pages reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: Autodesk explicitly warns that group-code table order is not a guaranteed entity order and can vary. DXF remains a sequence of code/value pairs with structural record/section markers and omission defaults. The group-code ranges distinguish arbitrary IDs (320-329), soft pointers (330-339), hard pointers (340-349), soft owners (350-359), and hard owners (360-369); XDATA 1005 handle values have soft-pointer translation behavior.

sources.revision: Stable documentation pages reviewed 2026-10-20; versioned docs identify ezdxf 1.4.5 for recovery/audit.
sources.observed: The handle model specifies unique handles and at most one owner per object, with $HANDSEED above the greatest handle as the expected high-water value. Strict loading and recover/audit are separate paths. Recovery can retain unrecoverable decode diagnostics and the documentation warns that rewriting such input may lose information or produce invalid DXF. This defines a useful diagnostic boundary, not an independent semantic oracle for all DXF content.

sources.revision: Mutable repository README and current dwgwrite man page reviewed 2026-10-20; man page identifies dwgwrite 0.14 and June 2026.
sources.observed: The repository README describes broader reader/writer capabilities but includes caveats for advanced read objects and later-version write errors. The current dwgwrite man page describes DWG writing as R2000-only; the README also identifies dxf2dwg as R2000-only. Treat each exact tool/operation contract as distinct rather than inferring coverage from the repository name or general README text.

sources.revision: Mutable master README support matrix reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The published direction-specific matrix declares AC1021 DWG reading supported and AC1021 DWG writing unsupported, while neighboring versions are marked differently. This is a project-declared capability, not per-feature correctness evidence or an executed differential.

localEvidence: The plan's existing PAR-16/7A policy distinguishes arbitrary handles, pointer/owner roles, contextual group codes, and XDATA 1005 translation.
The plan already records HANDSEED integrity and finalization controls, plus generated tests for legal source-order variation, record sentinels, graph closure, and atomic refusal/retry.
The plan already separates strict parsing, recovery/audit, peer parsing, native-consumer acceptance, and geometry/modeler semantics; no duplicate test owner was identified in this research pass.

validation.result: Plan-only update. No build, unit/CTest, peer executable, converter, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was run. Local checks were read-only searches of the plan and existing test sources.

assessment.implementationReadinessDelta: Use at most one generated legal-order permutation in an existing parser test owner if an actual uncovered path is found; keep structural delimiters and repeated payload order fixed. At the composed checkpoint, bind a peer to exact tool/revision, operation, direction, version, and feature, and record strict and recovery/audit results separately. Continue local work if optional external evidence is unavailable.

limitations: Public project documentation describes declared scope and may be mutable; it does not establish per-feature interoperability or the behavior of an unpinned binary.
No peer or native output was produced, parsed, or compared, and no external sample was downloaded.
This research does not resolve ACIS/ACDS semantics or any of the six DEFERRED_EXTERNAL qualification items.
